name: 雄霸天下III
group_note: genuine 1997-2001-era mudlib per its own readme (a fengyun-derived fork); shipped as 4 split zip parts (XB.ZIP.1-4) requiring binary concatenation, containing 12 nested per-directory tar.gz files instead of a flat tree -- joined and extracted before conversion; boots clean with zero fixes needed. Full WASM pass: fixed the euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc's make_body(); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds; guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() defensively; no band.lpc ships with this archive at all (BAN_D is never referenced from logind.lpc, so nothing to guard). Two socket-dependent daemons failed to compile, each independently breaking a different part of the game: adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc (intermud UDP, broke login for every connection since the boot flow touches it transitively) and adm/daemons/network/smtp.lpc (raw-SMTP mail sending, broke natured.lpc's periodic checks) -- both gutted to no-ops per AGENTS.md §7.52. Also found and fixed: a missing /topten/ directory crashing toptend.lpc's save on every world-entry (mkdir -p'd it); and cmds/usr/score.lpc dividing by EXPLORE_D->query_total_explore() unguarded, which is legitimately 0 before any exploration data has been scanned, crashing every score command on a fresh install (guarded with a ternary). Registration through world-entry, look/score/quit, and admin recognition all cleanly verified. Note the registration flow includes both a class/occupation choice (enchanter/fighter, spelled in English) and a y/n confirmation of that choice, plus an intro tutorial room before the real starting area.
